item.title: Top players Mango, Cody Schwab and aMSa all imply retirement from competitive Super Smash Bros. Melee
item.description: <p>25 years ago, Super Smash Bros. Melee was released for the Nintendo GameCube. It's incredible that the game still sees a developing meta in a highly competitive scene today.</p> <p>However, it would seem that some of Super Smash Bros. Melee best competitors have issued statements of their "soft retirements" from the scene. As a result, it feels as though the tournament scene for Super Smash Bros. Melee is heading towards an unknown direction.</p>

item.title: 2XKO Season 1 release and lengthy update maintenance times revealed
